capabilities.name: Admit bounded operation
capabilities.purpose: Turn a declared request into an idempotent, authority-bound operation record.
capabilities.status_reason: Pre-first-use source capability; no release classification is inferred. The broker, journal and HTTP seams are implemented in the inspected source; this lane did not run them or establish owner observation.
network_requirements: HTTP edge only when called through the web API
capabilities.trust_boundary: Authenticated caller crosses the edge into cooperating hub code; the hub persists the frozen envelope before any executor dispatch.
capabilities.egress: Admission itself does not dispatch to a provider; later operation-specific execution may egress.
capabilities.authority: Principal route right, declared capability, hard prerequisites and interruption policy.

sources.claim: Parses the request, checks specification/authority/causality, creates the operation and enters decision or refusal.
Scopes idempotency by principal identity and idempotency key and refuses an envelope mismatch.
Exposes the kernel submit surface.

tests.assertion: Admission follows the four authority layers in order.
Refusal leaves terminal evidence and prohibited stream content is rejected.

limitations: No live HTTP or database run was performed.
Application-level admission is not an OS sandbox.

capabilities.name: Recover runtime work
capabilities.purpose: Resolve interrupted parent, liveness and publication state after startup.
capabilities.status_reason: Pre-first-use source capability; no release classification is inferred. Startup ordering and recovery code are present; this lane did not run a restart or live recovery.
capabilities.trust_boundary: Startup trusts durable operation evidence before it repairs read projections; an absent completion proof remains uncertain.
capabilities.egress: Recovery does not call a provider; it may mark work for operator review.
capabilities.authority: Internal runtime recovery with liveness and publication guards; it cannot invent a success receipt.

sources.claim: Reconciles parent state and liveness before repairing projections.
Expires unclaimed work as refusal and silent claimed work as indeterminate.
Guards transitions while publication owns the fence.

tests.assertion: Approved work past claim deadline becomes a refusal.
Claimed work past execution deadline becomes indeterminate.
Restart replay preserves journal cursor and receipt behavior.

limitations: Restart behavior was inferred from source and assertions, not observed.
Provider-side completion after a lost response remains unknown.

capabilities.name: Run one physical inference attempt
capabilities.purpose: Bind one provider attempt to a deployment revision, route boundary and receipt.
capabilities.status_reason: Pre-first-use source capability; no release classification is inferred. The one-child/one-receipt path and cancellation handling are implemented, but provider and platform readiness are external or unverified here.
network_requirements: provider or mesh network when target is remote
capabilities.trust_boundary: The runner dispatches only after a kernel warrant and exact deployment/target binding; provider output returns as evidence, not authority.
capabilities.egress: Prompt/context may leave the machine only through the selected provider route; the bound egress reference and destination are recorded without placing content in the kernel journal.
capabilities.authority: Admitted child operation, valid warrant, live parent, route policy and exact deployment revision.

sources.claim: Validates exact fields, deadline and content-free invocation origin.
Resolves deployment revision/target/placement and binds an egress reference.
Persists durable receipt before terminal publication and marks unknown dispatch outcome indeterminate.
Requires valid result reference and inference evidence for a terminal receipt.

tests.assertion: Fallback is represented as a separate physical child and receipt.
The inference-runner fixture journal omits its prompt, output and audio bodies; this does not cover parent snapshot storage.
A cancelled reference invocation cannot publish late stream output.

limitations: Provider availability, model quality and actual egress depend on configured adapters.
No live provider call was made.

capabilities.name: Derive principals and route rights
capabilities.purpose: Authenticate owner, agent and node callers and apply route-specific rights.
capabilities.status_reason: Pre-first-use source capability; no release classification is inferred. Principal kinds, credential hashing, expiry/revocation and centralized route mapping are implemented; runtime deployment was not exercised.
capabilities.trust_boundary: The edge derives identity from credentials; caller payloads cannot declare principal kind or rights.
capabilities.egress: Authentication and route authorization do not dispatch operation content.
capabilities.authority: Owner token or issued credential; route rights are deny-by-default and principal-specific.

sources.claim: Defines owner, agent, node, scheduler, service and none identities and their rights.
Stores token hashes, caps TTL, checks expiry and compares hashes constant-time.
Centralizes route rights and uses owner fallback for protected routes.

tests.assertion: Agent identity comes from the credential and owner-only rights refuse.
A node credential does not derive owner identity.
Expired agent credentials are rejected.

limitations: Credentials are in-memory and wiped on process restart.
Public route exceptions are explicit but deployment topology was not tested.

capabilities.name: Resolve operation control mode
capabilities.purpose: Evaluate hard invariants, grants, control mode and feature defaults for a concrete effect.
capabilities.status_reason: Pre-first-use source capability; no release classification is inferred. Policy matrices and authority service are implemented and assertions were inspected; no live control-mode change was made.
capabilities.trust_boundary: Policy resolves authority for exact scope; it cannot add a destination or loosen hard invariants.
capabilities.egress: Resolution is local; an allowed operation may egress later through its adapter.
capabilities.authority: Precedence is hard invariants, revocation, exact grant, control mode, feature default.

sources.claim: Defines hard invariants, modes and supported operation families.
Evaluates authority and issues/revokes bounded grants through the service.
Refuses unsupported families and applies family-specific mode rules.

tests.assertion: All modes preserve hard invariants.
Unsupported families fail closed.
A proposal captures its policy snapshot for later operation decisions.

limitations: Policy code presence is not owner observation.
Destination registration and external adapter readiness are separate checks.

capabilities.name: Reconcile SQLite shape
capabilities.purpose: Bring an existing database toward the declared additive schema shape on open.
capabilities.status_reason: Pre-first-use source capability; no release classification is inferred. Shape-based reconciliation and focused assertions are present; this lane did not open a live database.
capabilities.trust_boundary: The reconciler mutates local schema additively and preserves existing rows; the informational version is not an authorization gate.
capabilities.egress: Schema reconciliation is local and does not send data.
capabilities.authority: Normal database-open path; additive general repair plus explicit legacy table/trigger rebuilds.

sources.claim: Defines the declared schema and informational version 79.
Creates missing shape, adds columns, runs idempotent repairs and stamps the database.
General shape reconciliation preserves unknown tables but invokes explicit known legacy rebuilds before normal schema repair.

tests.assertion: A missing table is restored by reconciliation.
A missing column is restored by reconciliation.
Unknown existing tables and rows survive reconciliation.
The registered bookmarks claim invokes real reconcile and observes the table recreated before the backup callback.

limitations: Generated schema inventory is declared base shape, not a live DB census.
Historical rebuild/backfill paths require concrete old-shape inspection.
Automatic backup follows some schema changes and independent backfills; it is not a guaranteed pre-upgrade snapshot.

capabilities.name: Back up and restore the database
capabilities.purpose: Create a timestamped SQLite backup and safely replace the database from a validated backup.
capabilities.status_reason: Pre-first-use source capability; no release classification is inferred. CLI and SQLite backup/restore primitives are implemented; no live backup or restore was run.
capabilities.trust_boundary: Restore replaces one local SQLite file only after validation and safety backup; other application stores are outside the snapshot.
capabilities.egress: Backup and restore are local filesystem operations.
capabilities.authority: Explicit operator command and restore confirmation; active owner database is refused.

sources.claim: Implements backup listing, confirmation and restore reporting.
Uses SQLite backup API, validates restore, makes safety backup and cleans sidecars.

tests.assertion: Kept data survives backup and restore and the database reopens.
An invalid/interrupted restore leaves the installation openable.

limitations: Does not snapshot config, audio, browser stores or People sidecar.
Restore is replacement and was not exercised here.

capabilities.name: Run operator diagnostics
capabilities.purpose: Report environment, database, connector, authority and host readiness with actionable fixes.
capabilities.status_reason: Pre-first-use source capability; no release classification is inferred. Doctor checks and CLI output are implemented; no local host or network was inspected by this lane.
persistence: log file only where configured; check results are not a canonical DB record
network_requirements: Some configured endpoint and cloud preflight checks may use network.
capabilities.trust_boundary: Doctor observes configured host and service seams; it does not grant authority or repair every failure.
capabilities.egress: Selected health/preflight checks can contact configured endpoints; connector listing skips other checks.
capabilities.authority: Operator invocation; strict changes exit interpretation only.

sources.claim: Collects runtime, config, DB, provider, host, connector, People and gate checks.
Prints checks and returns nonzero for failures or strict warnings.
Remote health helpers use short-timeout configured HTTP calls.

limitations: Output depends on the host, configuration and network.
Doctor is diagnostic and does not prove future provider success.

capabilities.name: Reject named stream-content keys in generic kernel material
capabilities.purpose: Reject the named audio, PCM and token keys recursively; this is not semantic secret or prompt classification.
capabilities.status_reason: Pre-first-use source capability; no release classification is inferred. Forbidden content keys and runner assertions are present; no runtime probe was run.
capabilities.trust_boundary: Generic inference receipts and parent input snapshots have different data boundaries. Parent input_json can retain caller content.
capabilities.egress: This negative capability does not egress content.
capabilities.authority: Kernel event validation; no caller may opt out for convenience.

sources.claim: Names audio, PCM, token and token-stream keys forbidden in journal material.
Appends hash-chained event records.
Verifies hash-chained event records.

tests.assertion: Forbidden stream content causes refusal and terminal evidence.
The inference-runner fixture journal omits its prompt, output and audio bodies; this does not cover parent snapshot storage.
The registered parent snapshot claim admits a real Sequence parent with a synthetic prompt and reads the same prompt back from input_json.

limitations: This is a cooperating-code control and not a same-user OS sandbox.
Native domain and provider stores have separate retention rules.
Prompt/transcript/completion strings are not all forbidden by the key filter; parent snapshots can contain request bodies.

capabilities.name: Deny agent decision and posture authority
capabilities.purpose: Keep agent credentials limited to their submit/read/usage/self-revoke scope.
capabilities.status_reason: Pre-first-use source capability; no release classification is inferred. Principal rights and HTTP decision guards are implemented and assertions were inspected.
capabilities.trust_boundary: Agent callers may propose bounded work, but owner-only decision and posture routes terminate before mutation.
capabilities.egress: The refusal path does not dispatch an effect.
capabilities.authority: Principal rights map explicitly excludes decide, posture and delegate for agents.

sources.claim: Agent rights omit decide, posture, delegate and node link.
Decision path checks owner decision authority and issues or rejects the warrant.

tests.assertion: Agent decision and caller envelope mutation are refused.
Agent calls cannot use owner-only rights.

limitations: Application route protection does not protect a compromised owner process.
No live HTTP authorization run was performed.

capabilities.name: Preserve unknown tables during general reconciliation
capabilities.purpose: Retain unrecognized tables and their rows during the general shape repair.
capabilities.status_reason: Internal preservation rule asserted for orphan tables; not a universal ban on DROP SQL.
capabilities.trust_boundary: Reconciliation may add local shape and registered backfills; it does not treat an unknown row as disposable.
capabilities.authority: General reconciliation does not sweep unknown tables; explicit legacy rebuilds are separate.

sources.claim: General shape reconciliation preserves unknown tables but invokes explicit known legacy rebuilds before normal schema repair.
Applies shape and idempotent repairs.

tests.assertion: An orphan table and its rows survive reconciliation.
An informational newer stamp does not block opening or discard data.

limitations: Additive policy does not make every historical table rebuild lossless without inspecting the concrete path.
Schema version is informational only.
Explicit known legacy tables and revised triggers are rebuilt. No universal no-DROP invariant is claimed.

sources.claim: Builds the trusted journal/codec/spec registry.

sources.claim: Owns connection cache, schema ensure/reconcile and database lifecycle.

integrations.purpose: Persist domain, authority, journal, receipt and projection state.

sources.claim: Configures WAL, foreign keys and busy timeout for SQLite connections.

integrations.auth: Filesystem access and SQLite connection ownership
secrets: Normal DB may contain sensitive local data; it is not generally encrypted by HoldSpeak.

tests.assertion: An informational newer stamp does not block opening or discard data.
An invalid/interrupted restore leaves the installation openable.

secrets: Provider credentials remain outside generic journal material; exact custody varies by adapter.

tests.assertion: Runner tests assert generic journal material omits sensitive content.
A cancelled reference invocation cannot publish late stream output.

relationships: proposal execution is evidenced by receipt

trust_boundaries.purpose: Keep caller identity and authority separate from operation payloads.

secrets: provider secrets excluded from generic envelope

trust_boundaries.purpose: Allow exactly the approved operation to be claimed and receipted.

sources.claim: Validates warrant, envelope, revocation, expiry and live ancestor before claim and receipt.

trust_boundaries.authority: owner-approved or policy-permitted warrant; node claim right
secrets: warrant signing key remains kernel custody

trust_boundaries.purpose: Constrain possible egress to the frozen route and preserve uncertainty when completion is lost.

sources.claim: Freezes deployment revision, target, placement and egress reference before dispatch.

trust_boundaries.authority: policy permit; exact destination; deadline; claim identity
secrets: adapter/provider credentials are outside generic journal material
